reason: An agent would typically list allowed directories to understand its accessible scope before attempting to list the contents of any specific directory.
An agent might search for directories matching a pattern and then choose one of the found directory paths to list its immediate contents.
After creating a new directory, an agent may want to list its contents to verify creation or inspect its initial state.
After moving a directory, an agent may want to list its contents at the new location to confirm the operation or inspect its new state.
